summary: Scage Future filed a Form 6-K reporting that Chairman and CEO Chao Gao resigned from the Audit Committee (effective June 27, 2026) for personal reasons, with no disagreement. Simultaneously, the Board appointed independent directors Kevin Chen as Audit Committee Chairman and Yixian Wang as a member; Chen qualifies as an audit committee financial expert. Additionally, independent director Yuanchi Guo resigned on June 25, 2026, for personal reasons, with no successor yet appointed. These board-level changes are abrupt but appear consensual. There are no deal terms; the filing is a routine governance update regarding director resignations and appointments, mapping to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 departure of directors or principal officers. Watch for possible further departures or governance shifts.
